desc: Where are the Kuzuluk hot springs, how hot is the water, how far from Sapanca? The Akyazı thermal spring, health warnings and a Sapanca + Kuzuluk weekend plan.
lead: The Kuzuluk hot springs are in Kuzuluk, in the Akyazı district of Sakarya, about 47 km (35–45 minutes) by road from Kırkpınar. According to an academic geology study, the spring's surface temperature is about 51 °C and its flow is 42 litres per second; this hot water is fed to the pools and cabins of the thermal facilities in the area. Staying in Sapanca and setting aside an afternoon for Kuzuluk is the most practical way to balance a nature trip with a relaxing break, especially on autumn and winter weekends.
body:
Summary
  • Location: Kuzuluk, Akyazı / Sakarya — ~47 km from Kırkpınar, 35–45 min.
  • Water: Spring surface temperature ~51 °C (academic measurement); pool temperature varies by facility.
  • Best season: Autumn and winter; the best plan B for rainy days.
  • Health: People with chronic conditions and pregnant women should consult a doctor first.

Where are the Kuzuluk hot springs and how do you get there from Sapanca?

Kuzuluk is a settlement east of Adapazarı, in the Akyazı district. From Kırkpınar you reach it by heading east on the Anatolian Motorway (TEM) and turning off towards Akyazı; according to map routing the road is about 47 km and around 35 minutes without traffic. Since the area can be busy on weekend afternoons and during holidays, allowing 45 minutes is more realistic.

FromDistanceApproximate time
Kırkpınar / DİDİ Otel~47 km35–45 min
Istanbul (Kadıköy)~165 km~2–2.5 hours

How hot is the water at Kuzuluk?

In a geology study of Kuzuluk's thermal water, the temperature of the spring at the surface is given as 51 °C and its flow as 42 litres per second. The pool water in the facilities is brought to a usable temperature by cooling and mixing the spring water; we recommend asking the facility about the pool temperature before you go.

What facilities are there in Kuzuluk?

In addition to businesses offering day-use pools and cabins, Kuzuluk also has thermal hotels with accommodation; for example Kuzuluk Termal, owned by the İhlas group, is one of the well-known facilities in the area. Day-entry conditions, prices and family/private cabin options vary from one business to another, so we do not give prices here; calling by phone is the most reliable way to find out.

What are thermal waters good for?

It is generally known that hot water reduces muscle tension and relaxes you; however, for claims that thermal water "is good for" a particular illness, a doctor's opinion is essential. In cases such as heart and circulatory conditions, high blood pressure, pregnancy or open wounds, consult your doctor before entering a thermal pool. For healthy adults too the general rule is the same: do not stay in hot water for a long time at a stretch, rest in between and drink plenty of water.

Back in Sapanca after the thermal break: DİDİ Otel, Kırkpınar.

A Sapanca + Kuzuluk weekend plan

On Sunday it makes sense to put Kuzuluk on the way home: after the thermal pool you can get onto the TEM relaxed and head back to Istanbul. For a longer programme, see our 3-day plan guide.

In November the average daytime high in Sapanca is around 17 °C; ideal for ending a walk in the colourful forests with a hot pool. Autumn guide

Stopping by Kuzuluk to rest your muscles after skiing in Kartepe is a good combination. Places to visit in winter

If rain has ruined your walking plans, a thermal pool is the best rescue. More ideas in our article on what to do in rainy weather.

Where to stay for a Kuzuluk trip?

Treating Kuzuluk as a day-trip break and staying by the lake lets you enjoy both experiences together. At DİDİ Otel Sapanca in Kırkpınar, breakfast is included with the stay (it is served as a plated breakfast at Mare Gastro; the serpme breakfast, the traditional Turkish spread, is available for an extra charge), and for dinner Mare Gastro in the garden is right next to you. We describe our jacuzzi room options in this article. For availability, you can write to us on WhatsApp.
faq: Where are the Kuzuluk hot springs?
They are in Kuzuluk, in the Akyazı district of Sakarya; about 47 km, or 35–45 minutes, from Kırkpınar by road.
How hot is the water at Kuzuluk?

According to an academic geology study, the spring's surface temperature is about 51 °C and its flow is 42 litres per second. The water in the pools is brought to a usable temperature; ask the facility for the current pool temperature.
What are the Kuzuluk hot springs good for?

Hot water is known for its relaxing effect; however, for claims that it is good for particular illnesses, a doctor's opinion is essential. If you have a chronic condition or are pregnant, consult your doctor first.
Can Kuzuluk be visited as a day trip from Sapanca?
Yes. With a 35–45 minute distance you can stay in Sapanca and set aside an afternoon for the thermal baths, or stop by on the way home on Sunday.
What is the best season for thermal baths?
Autumn and winter are the most enjoyable times; it is also a good alternative on rainy days.
